entities.summary: Tokugawa Akitake  was a younger half-brother of the Japanese Samurai, Daimyo and Shōgun Tokugawa Yoshinobu and final daimyō of Mito Domain. He represented the Tokugawa shogunate at the courts of several European powers during the final days of Bakumatsu period Japan.
